description: Get the DB parameters a user has changed on a cluster (GET /mysql/v1/clusters/{clusterName}/config) — only overrides, as strings. For every parameter with defaults and current values use ncloud_serverless_list_config_parameters.

clusterName.description: Cluster name (3-30 chars, lowercase letters/digits/'-', no leading or trailing '-'; immutable after creation)

name: ncloud_serverless_get_config
